desc: The Daniel Defense DD4 Pistol delivers premium AR-platform performance in a compact, maneuverable package. Built with Daniel Defense's renowned cold hammer-forged barrel, precision-machined components, and rugged construction, it offers exceptional accuracy, reliability, and durability for training, personal defense, or recreational shooting. Its lightweight design, free-floating M-LOK handguard, and high-quality fit and finish make the DD4 Pistol an outstanding choice for shooters seeking uncompromising performance in a compact firearm.
